thesis: The volume examines recognition of novelty through foundations, limits and experimental validation.

ideas.statement: Novelty, familiarity and apparent originality are different objects of analysis.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Can language models recognize what they have never encountered?
Foundations, informational limits and experimental validation
An analysis of the difference between genuine novelty, familiarity and the appearance of originality.
